scaled_whitebox_docmia.description: White-box document-level membership inference on DocVQA-style data. Paper reference is the DocMIA white-box Donut/DocVQA setting from Table 11 and Table 12.

balanced_accuracy.description: Class-balanced membership accuracy on the document split.

matthews_corrcoef.description: Diagnostic correlation-style classification score that penalizes class collapse.

roc_auc.description: Diagnostic threshold-free ranking quality of membership scores.

average_precision.description: Diagnostic precision-recall ranking quality for member documents.

tpr_at_1_fpr.description: Member-document true positive rate at 1 percent false positive rate.

tpr_at_3_fpr.description: Member-document true positive rate at 3 percent false positive rate.

predicted_member_rate_imbalance.description: Diagnostic absolute distance between the predicted member rate and the balanced evaluation prior.

max_questions_per_document.description: Declared maximum number of document questions consumed by the attack.

uses_auxiliary_data.description: Penalty flag for methods that use auxiliary or shadow data.

constraint_metadata_missing.description: Diagnostic flag when required query-budget or auxiliary-data metadata is absent.

label_copy_suspect.description: Diagnostic flag for artifacts whose raw binary outputs directly copy known split labels.
